Random-entry control: 200 draws from one generator seeded 11, without replacement, from the SAME window's bars, same direction/stop-distance/R as the matched real trade, net of cost1 only. DSR at N=24 uses the per-trade-Sharpe dispersion of THIS RUN'S OWN 16 trials in the same window as SR0's pool (the 8 gold trials are not available to this standalone unit, and are not yet run at all per A40b).
